description: Launch prices per beer in four formats (200ml bottle ₹99 against a ₹129 MRP, 250ml can ₹119 against ₹149, 330ml bottle ₹139 against ₹179, 500ml can ₹199 against ₹249; each format also in a 6-pack at six times the single price), delivery cities (India is the first market; delivery in Bangalore only for now, then Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Jaipur next), and the flat delivery fee.
name: get_pricing_and_delivery
title: Pricing, packs, and delivery
